move: square bento pops in, wipes uncover photos, counters run, wipes close
how: A 1:1 three-by-three bento grid (tall photo cell on the right, ticker cell hidden) of white, black, yellow and blue cells plus three photo cells. All cells scale in from 0.85 and opacity 0 (expo.out 0.9s, 100ms stagger) at 0; a stage-coloured wipe plane over each photo cell collapses to scaleX 0 from the left (expo.inOut 0.9s, 150ms stagger) from 5%, revealing photos that slowly settle from scale 1.25 to 1.05 over 90% of the loop. Category chips drop in from y -30 with back.out(2), headings, labels, logo and dots lift in from y 26 (power3.out, 60ms stagger), a big stat counts 0 to 48 with expo.out over 1.6s from 10%, and three dots blink in sequence (opacity yoyo repeats). Mid-loop at 45% the photo cells lift 12px and scale 1.02 yoyo while their images drift (xPercent -6 / yPercent 5, sine.inOut 4s) and the stat cell rocks -2deg. At 81% the wipes close back over the photos from the right (expo.inOut) and at 89% the cells collapse to 0.85 and fade in reverse order.
adapt: Replace the studio name, tagline, chip labels, stat target (data-to), the three photos and the four brand colours; grid-area assignments give the square layout. Keep the 0.9s expo.out pop at 100ms stagger, the 0.9s expo.inOut wipe and the 45% mid-loop lift.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the 3x3 grid, cells and wipe planes inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with labels at fractions of D; counter tweens must select .n inside el. Identical script to bento-16-9, only the CSS grid differs.
caveats: catalog says 20s but render.json duration is 10s
from() tweens throughout; use immediateRender:false when built late
ends on an empty stage, not the first frame
